title: New England Patriots Legend Willie McGinest Arrested For Assault
htmlContent:
Law enforcement officers tell us TMZ Sports. Willie McGinest turned himself in, in connection with an alleged attack in the last two weeks.

Per TMZ Sports, New England Patriots Three-Time Super Bowl Champion Willie McGinest has been arrested in Los Angeles.

New England Patriots legend Willie McGinest has been arrested in Los Angeles. Jail records show the former NFL star was booked around 7:30 on Monday morning. His bail has been set at $30,000.

McGinest, a first-round pick at the 1994 NFL Draft, played in the league for 15 years and is considered one of the greatest Patriots ever.

Turns out he was arrested for an assault charge after nightclub appearance in Hollywood.

We are aware of the incident and the video, which is disturbing. Willie McGinest will not appear on NFL Network while we review the matter,” an NFL Network spokesperson told The Post. 

McGinest had a 15-year career in the NFL playing defensive end and linebacker after being selected No. 4 overall in 2004 NFL Draft by the New England out of USC.
